CREATE TABLE [syn].[STG_BOB_TBLCORPUSR]

	[BDAY] [nvarchar](50)  NULL,
	[CD] [nvarchar](20)  NULL,
	[CORP_ID] [nvarchar](32)  NULL,
	[EMAIL] [nvarchar](100)  NULL,
	[FIRST_NM] [nvarchar](100)  NULL,
	[LANDLINE_NO] [nvarchar](30)  NULL,
	[LAST_NM] [nvarchar](100)  NULL,
	[MIDDLE_NM] [nvarchar](100)  NULL,
	[MOBILE_NO] [nvarchar](30)  NULL,
	[STATUS] [int]  NULL,
	[TITLE] [nvarchar](20)  NULL,
	[ROLE] numeric(2,0),
	[BANK_CODE] [nvarchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [nvarchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [nvarchar](50)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL,
	CONSTRAINT PK_STG_BOB_TBLCORPUSR PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (ID) NOT ENFORCED
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
